dos: Do render each project from its own facts at its own scale and angle.
Do keep motion per-section with transform/opacity under 300ms.
Do keep tilt, tape, and pegs static across motion preferences.
Do tint secondary text from ink; use tabular numerals.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette.
donts: Don't ship uniform cards, pill buttons, or identical hovers/reveals.
Don't use gradients, glass, auroras, particles, or emoji icons.
Don't set kickers, colored left borders, or sticky nav.
Don't use mono as decoration or new hues.
Don't leave headers as vague nouns.
keyCharacteristics: Bleed, tilt, tape, and overlap — never an even grid.
Every project rendered from its own facts.
Headers make claims; tabs stay literal.
Motion is per-section vocabulary; tilt is layout.
narrative.northStar: Metro panorama crossed with a punk flyer wall
narrative.overview: A personal site that feels like stepping into the owner's workshop. Rebuilt a second time after the first draft defaulted to uniform cards and pills; the Metro panorama of the owner's own most-starred repo crossed with a taped-up flyer wall keeps every section structurally distinct.
